Proposed demo windows (all US/PST) — pick one or send alternatives:
- Tue Dec 2, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Dec 3, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Dec 4, 09:00–10:00

I’ve attached a suggested agenda and a short capacity checklist (capacity-checklist.xlsx) to make it easy to fill in the bits Marissa will need. If you prefer a 45-minute focused demo + 15-min Q&A, say the word.

If you want, loop in your security lead and procurement contact now so we can surface any firewall/contract questions early.

Thanks — I’ll hold the windows until I hear back and coordinate with Marissa & Ben on the right demo resources.
